🎥🎬: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth (2026)

Eight years after his Hollywood adventures, Cliff Booth has found a new way to make a living. No longer a stuntman, he’s become the guy powerful people call when their problems get too dangerous to handle themselves. But in 1977 Los Angeles, some problems are better left untouched.

When a mysterious assignment involving television star Charlie Peters lands on his doorstep, Cliff is pulled into a criminal underworld filled with secrets, murder, blackmail, and dangerous alliances. With gangsters closing in and Hollywood’s biggest personalities hiding dark secrets, Cliff must rely on the same instincts that kept him alive in the past.

Starring Brad Pitt and directed by David Fincher, with a screenplay by Quentin Tarantino.
